buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR PROCUREMENT OF SILAGE 1. Scope of Supply The supplier shall supply good-quality silage as per the specifications, quantity and delivery sched ule mentioned in the GeM Bid/BOQ. The material shall be suitable for consumption by livestock, pa rticularly cattle. 2. Quality and Specifications S.No Particular Quantity 1 Silage 150 Quintal · The silage shall be prepared from good-quality green fodder, preferably maize or other approved fodder crops. · The silage shall be properly fermented, nutritious, palatable and free from harmful substan ces. · The material shall be free from fungus, mould, rotten matter, foreign materials, soil, stone s and other contaminants. · Silage shall not have any foul, putrid or abnormal smell. · The moisture content and nutritional quality shall be suitable for livestock consumption.

· The supplied material shall be fresh, properly preserved and fit for animal consumption. 3. Quantity The supplier shall supply the exact quantity of silage as specified in the GeM Bid/BOQ. Any shortag e or excess supply shall be dealt with as per the terms of the GeM contract and approval of the co mpetent authority. 4. Delivery · The supplier shall deliver the entire quantity at the designated location, i.e. Catt le Breeding Farm (CBF), Kurbathang, Kargil, or any other location specified by the de partment. · Transportation, loading, unloading and all other incidental expenses shall be borne by the supplier. · The supplier shall ensure timely delivery within the stipulated period mentioned in the Ge M contract. · No additional transportation or handling charges shall be payable by the department. 5. Inspection and Quality Verification · The supplied silage shall be subject to physical inspection and quality verification by the d epartmental committee constituted by the Chief Animal Husbandry Officer, Kargil. · The committee shall verify the quantity, quality, condition and suitability of the silage befo re acceptance. · The department reserves the right to collect samples for laboratory testing, wherever cons idered necessary. · The decision regarding acceptance or rejection of the supplied material shall be taken by t he competent authority on the basis of the inspection report. 6. Rejection of Material · Any material found substandard, contaminated, fungus-affected, rotten or otherwise unfit f or animal consumption shall be rejected. · The supplier shall replace the rejected material with fresh and acceptable quality silage at his own cost within the period specified by the department. · No payment shall be made for rejected or unaccepted material. · The supplier shall bear all expenses relating to the removal and replacement of rejected m aterial. 7. Payment Terms · Payment shall be released only after satisfactory delivery, physical verification and accept ance of the supplied material by the departmental committee. · Payment shall be processed through the prescribed GeM payment mechanism after submis sion of the required invoice and supporting documents. · No advance payment shall be made unless specifically permitted under the applicable Ge M terms and conditions. 8. Weighment and Measurement · The quantity supplied shall be verified through proper weighment at the designated delive ry point.

· The weighment shall be carried out in the presence of the departmental representatives/c ommittee. · The weighment slip/receipt shall be submitted along with the invoice for verification and p ayment. · Payment shall be restricted to the actual quantity received and accepted by the departme nt, subject to the contract terms. 1. The Client reserves the right to: 1. Increase or Decrease the Quantity: The Client may, at its sole discretion, increase or decrease the quantity of the items mentioned in the tender at any stage—either before the award of the contract or du ring the execution of the contract—based on actual field requirements, budget avail ability, administrative considerations, or any unforeseen circumstances. The supplie r shall be bound to accept such variations in quantity at the same rates, terms, and conditions as specified in the tender and the resultant contract. 2. Cancel, Postpone, or Modify the Tender: The Client reserves full authority to cancel, postpone, withdraw, or modify the tender process, wholly or in part, without assigning any reason. This may include sit uations where the budget provision is revised, delayed, curtailed, or withdrawn, or where administrative, technical, operational, or policy-related circumstances warran t such action. In such cases, the Client shall not be liable for any claim, compensati on, or financial loss incurred by any bidder due to the cancellation or modification o f the tender. 2. All bidders will have to submit EMD@2% of contract value MSME and start-up are exempt ed from EMD amount. 3. Successful bidder shall submit the performance security @3% of contract value. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG: Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the for m of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per Gem GTC). D D should be made in favour of Chief Animal Husbandry Officer, Kargil. 5. Any dispute shall be resolved as per GeM dispute resolution mechanism. 6. Jurisdiction of any legal proceedings shall lie in the court of the Kargil district. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
